detail.title: Intex LED-SFFV4361 43” FHD Smart TV with Cloud OS
detail.overview: Experience a smarter way to watch with the all-new Intex LED-SFFV4361. Designed for the modern home, this 43-inch Smart TV combines a sleek frameless aesthetic with powerful performance and immersive audio. Powered by the latest Android 14 (Cloud TV OS) and a high-speed Quad-Core processor, it delivers seamless streaming of your favorite content from apps like Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, Sony LIV, and more. Whether it's the pixel-perfect clarity of the A+ Grade panel or the room-filling sound of the 24W down-firing speakers, every detail is crafted to evolve your home entertainment experience.
